Government of Bangladesh: The Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh issued this notification through the Ministry of Finance.
Ministry of Finance: This ministry is the authority under which the Internal Resources Division operates and issues official notifications.
Internal Resources Division: This division of the Ministry of Finance serves as the administrative body for customs and value added tax matters in Bangladesh.

Customs Act 2023: This Act serves as the primary legal authority for granting customs duty exemptions.
Section 25(1) of this Act empowers the government to provide duty exemptions on specific goods in the public interest after consulting with the National Board of Revenue.
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: Section 126(1) of this Act provides the legal basis for granting exemptions from value added tax on the specified goods.
National Board of Revenue: The Board must be consulted by the government before issuing notifications to grant customs duty or value added tax exemptions.
Customs Duty: The exemption provides that for the listed goods, any customs duty exceeding one percent ad valorem is waived.
Value Added Tax: The exemption provides for a full waiver of value added tax on the importation of the goods specified in the table, subject to prescribed conditions.
Goods: The goods listed in the table, comprising specific internal combustion engines and AC generators, are eligible for customs duty and value added tax exemptions.

Industrial IRC Holder: This term is defined as an entity that possesses a valid and current Industrial Consumer Import Registration Certificate issued by the Office of the Chief Controller of Imports and Exports.
Importers must hold this certification to qualify for specific industrial import privileges.
VAT Compliant: This term refers to a manufacturing entity that is registered under the Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012.
To meet this status, the entity must regularly submit its required tax returns.
Generator Manufacturing or Assembling In: Entities must belong to this specific industrial sector and satisfy both the Industrial IRC holder and VAT compliant status requirements to be eligible for relevant import concessions.

(২) এই প্রজ্ঞাপনের আওতায় পণ্য আমদানি ও খালাসের লক্ষ্যে প্রতিষ্ঠানটির হালনাগাদ নবায়িত শিল্প ভোক্তা আইআরসি রহিয়াছে এবং ১৩ ডিজিট সংবলিত মূল্য সংযোজন কর (মূসক) নিবন্ধিত প্রতিষ্ঠানটি বিবেচনা বিল অব এন্ট্রি দাখিলের অব্যবহিত পূর্ববর্তী মাসের মূসক দাখিলপত্র (রিটার্ন) দাখিল করিয়াছে মর্মে কাস্টমস কম্পিউটার সিস্টেমে বা ভ্যাট অনলাইন সিস্টেমে বা জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড এর ওয়েবসাইটে বা ভ্যাট কমিশনারেট এর ওয়েবসাইটে ইলেকট্রনিক তথ্য প্রদর্শিত থাকিতে হইবে:

তবে শর্ত থাকে যে, কোনো ধরনের দৈব-দুর্বিপাক বা কোনো যৌক্তিক কারণে ইলেকট্রনিক তথ্য পাওয়া সম্ভব না হইলে সংশ্লিষ্ট কমিশনার অব কাস্টমস প্রতি ক্ষেত্রে কারণ লিপিবদ্ধ করিয়া শুল্কায়নের প্রয়োজনীয় কার্যক্রম গ্রহণ করিতে পারিবে;

Import Registration Certificate: The importing entity must possess a valid and updated industrial consumer import registration certificate for the import and clearance of goods under this order.
Value Added Tax: The entity must have a thirteen-digit value added tax registration and must have submitted the return for the month immediately preceding the filing of the bill of entry.
Customs Computerised Entry Processing Sy: The system must electronically display the status of value added tax return compliance for the importing entity.
National Board of Revenue: The official website of the National Board of Revenue serves as a valid repository for electronically verifying the value added tax compliance status of importing entities.
Commissioner of Customs: In cases where electronic data is unavailable due to force majeure or other logical reasons, the Commissioner of Customs is authorized to record the reasons and proceed with the necessary customs clearance operations.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: (৩) আমদানিকারক প্রতিষ্ঠানকে বিনিয়োগ উন্নয়ন কর্তৃপক্ষ কর্তৃক নিবন্ধিত স্থানীয়ভাবে Generator প্রস্তুতকারী অথবা Generator Assembling প্রতিষ্ঠান হইতে হইবে;

Generator Manufacturing or Assembling In: Importing entities must be registered with the Bangladesh Investment Development Authority as local manufacturers or assemblers of generators to qualify for the benefits of this order.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: (৪) আমদানিকৃত মালামালের পরিমাণ ও ব্যবহার নিশ্চিতকরণে পণ্যচালান শুল্কায়ন তথা খালাসকলে আমদানিকারক প্রতিষ্ঠানকে অত্র প্রজ্ঞাপনের পরিশিষ্ট-১ অনুযায়ী স্থানীয় কাস্টমস্, এক্সাইজ ও ভ্যাট বিভাগীয় কার্যালয় কর্তৃক এবং পরিশিষ্ট-২ অনুযায়ী এলসি ইস্যুকারী ব্যাংক কর্তৃক প্রদত্ত প্রত্যয়নপত্র সংগ্রহপূর্বক সংশ্লিষ্ট কমিশনার অব কাস্টমস এর বরাবর দাখিল করিতে হইবে;

Customs Clearance: The process of clearing imported goods requires importers to submit specific certification documents to the relevant Commissioner of Customs.
Importers must ensure the quantity and end-use of the imported goods are verified and documented as part of the customs clearance procedure.
Importer: Importers are obligated to obtain certifications from the local Customs, Excise and VAT office and the issuing bank for the letter of credit.
Importers must formally submit these mandatory certifications to the Commissioner of Customs to facilitate the assessment and clearance of their goods.
Commissioner of Customs: The Commissioner of Customs acts as the receiving authority for the required certifications submitted by importers to verify the quantity and use of imported goods.
Customs, Excise and VAT Department: This department is responsible for issuing a specific certification required for the clearance of imported goods, as specified in the annex of the notification.
Bank: The bank that issues the letter of credit is required to provide a certification concerning the imported goods to assist in the customs clearance process.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: (৫) Registered Generator প্রস্তুতকারী অথবা Generator Assembling প্রতিষ্ঠান কর্তৃক পরিশিষ্ট-৩ অনুযায়ী যথাযথ মূল্যমানের নন-জুডিশিয়াল স্ট্যাম্পে একটি অঙ্গীকারনামা প্রদান করিতে হইবে।

Generator Manufacturing or Assembling In: These industries are required to provide an undertaking on non-judicial stamp paper of an appropriate value.
The submission of this undertaking must be in accordance with the procedures and requirements stipulated in the third appendix of the order.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: (৬) পণ্য খালাস হওয়ার ৩০ (ত্রিশ) দিনের মধ্যে স্থানীয় কাস্টমস, এক্সাইজ ও ভ্যাট বিভাগ হইতে পরিশিষ্ট-৪ অনুযায়ী একটি প্রত্যয়নপত্র সংশ্লিষ্ট কমিশনার অব কাস্টমস বরাবরে দাখিল করিতে হইবে;

Customs Clearance: Following the completion of customs clearance for goods, the importer or authorized representative is required to submit a specific certificate to the relevant customs authority within a fixed timeframe.
The certification process must be carried out in accordance with the prescribed format provided in the relevant regulatory appendix.
Commissioner of Customs: The Commissioner of Customs is the designated authority to receive the mandatory certification document verifying compliance after the release of goods.
Submission of this certification to the Commissioner of Customs must occur within the statutory period following the clearance of the goods.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: (৭) শর্ত (৫) অনুযায়ী প্রদত্ত অঙ্গীকার লঙ্ঘিত হইয়াছে মর্মে প্রমাণিত হইলে, আমদানিকৃত যন্ত্রপাতি ও যন্ত্রাংশের উপর প্রযোজ্য সমুদয় শুল্ক ও কর মাসিক ৫% (পাঁচ শতাংশ) সুদসহ আদায়যোগ্য হইবে।

Customs Duty and Taxes: In the event of a breach of the required undertaking for imported machinery and spare parts, all applicable duties and taxes become due and payable.
A monthly interest charge is applied to the total amount of overdue duties and taxes until the liability is satisfied.

Generator Manufacturing or Assembling In: This certification acknowledges an entity as a registered generator assembling plant, verifying its registration status and operational engagement in assembly activities.
The certification confirms that the imported machinery, components, and materials are intended to be utilized within the established production process of the assembly plant.
Compliance is verified through physical inspection of the facility, including the review of ownership documents and operational status by the relevant VAT department authorities.
Imported Plant and Equipment: The certification validates that specific machinery, parts, and materials imported under identified letters of credit, invoices, and shipping documents are for legitimate industrial use by the registered assembly entity.

Generator Manufacturing or Assembling In: The importer must submit a formal undertaking confirming that the imported machinery, components, and materials are exclusively used for assembly operations within their own industrial plant.

The entity is liable to pay all applicable customs duties, taxes, interest, and penalties if an investigation by customs or value-added tax authorities reveals that the imported goods were not fully utilized for the specified assembly purpose.
The entity must accept any legal penalties or actions taken by customs authorities under the Customs Act 2023 for any violations regarding the use of the imported goods.
Customs Act 2023: This Act serves as the primary legal framework under which customs authorities are empowered to enforce penalties and recover duties, taxes, and interest for non-compliance with import conditions.
